title: fix(docs): fix dead links in routing.html
body:
\*\* Summary \*\*

1. Relative routing does not work as expected because there is `<base href="/v2/" />` at the top.
   Added routing.html in the url path to fix it

2. `#history-router-api` was not the correct anchor. Replaced it with `#instantsearchroutershistory-api`
